basis: Selected from the independently audited exploratory panel before observing fresh confirmation outcomes. Includes positive, negative, and uncertain comparisons.
risk_definition: Points already at risk BEFORE collecting either selection from the fixed roll.
difference_definition: Right branch match points minus left branch match points; the right branch retains the specified multiple or subset and rolls.
inference: Report the usual paired normal 95% interval, and separately use a predeclared conservative three-standard-error sign screen across these 12 comparisons. This is a normal-approximation multiplicity screen, not an exact simultaneous interval. No retuning or new checkpoint selection based on these outcomes.
